card.name: Charme
card.tagline: Rio's soul/R&B 'charme' dance scene of Madureira.
card.profile: Charme is a soul, funk and R&B dance scene that emerged in Rio de Janeiro, centered on the Baile Charme do Viaduto de Madureira (under the Viaduto Negrao de Lima), which began on 1 May 1990 out of the carnival bloco Pagodao de Madureira. Dancers perform choreographed steps to African-American soul, funk and R&B and Afro-Brazilian black music. The space was recognized as a Cultural Asset of Immaterial Nature of the City of Rio de Janeiro in 2013 (Agencia Brasil; Sesc RJ).
card.insight: DJ Corello popularized the term 'charme' in Rio's black-music bailes between the 1980s and 1990s; the Madureira baile marked its 35th anniversary in May 2025 (Agencia Brasil, 2025).

observation.setting: A large indoor public open space with tiled flooring and a high ceiling, possibly a station or pavilion, with spectators watching from the sides.
observation.dancers: A large mixed-gender group of youths, young adults, and older adults, dancing together.
observation.formation_and_space: Dancers form loose lines and rows facing forward, moving in place with occasional synchronous step variations.
observation.posture: Upright yet relaxed upper body, with knees softly bent and weight transferring smoothly from foot to foot.
observation.footwork: Rhythmic stepping and weight shifts on the beat, featuring heel drops, toe taps, kicks, and sliding steps.
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms swing naturally or move in coordination with the steps, sometimes bent at the elbow with relaxed hands.
observation.hips_and_torso: Subtle hip movement and torso shifts accompanying the footwork and arm gestures.
observation.partnering: None; individuals dance alongside each other in lines without physical contact.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Staying mostly at a medium standing level, with slight knee bobs and occasional turns or directional shifts.
observation.costume_and_props: Casual everyday wear including t-shirts, tank tops, jeans, shorts, leggings, caps, and sneakers.
observation.cannot_infer: Exact nuances of lower body weight transfer and rapid foot articulation are obscured by camera movement and video compression.

A side-to-side stepping sequence combined with alternating foot taps and rhythmic arm swings.
A syncopated stepping movement with heel drops and light shoulder bounces on the beat.
